text:
sara_sales: FYI procurement pushed back the POC order form. Three main asks: net60, PO required before start, and tax ID + W9 on file. Also legal noted a DPA carveout request for deletion-on-request. Need fast routing and a position.

julia_revops: Please drop the latest order form and their marked-up PDF here so I don't grab the wrong version from email.

sara_sales: Uploaded: https://redwood.docs/poc/acme/order_form_v3.pdf and procurement_comments_acme.pdf. They want DocuSign via their vendor portal and invoice flow to their AP system (separate PO #).

mike_legal: Reading the marked PDF now. DPA asks: explicit deletion within 30 days, mandatory subprocessor list enumerated in contract, and a 1-year cap on "operational logs" retention. Those are non-standard for us.

laura_security: Security will provide SOC2 summary but they also want KMS keys to be resident in their region (eu-west-1). Our hosted KMS is us-west-2 by default. For KMS residency we need Private deployment or a Dedicated config.

 tim_engineer: From infra side, we can offer a private deployment (customer-managed KMS) for the POC. That increases cost — I'll put together a delta between hosted and private options (GPU/hour, storage, ops). ETA EOD.

sara_sales: Procurement also expects the e-sign envelope to route through three internal approvers at their side: Sourcing -> Legal -> Finance, then back to Redwood. They prefer DocuSign. Any blockers?

mike_legal: DocuSign is acceptable if routing preserves our countersign mailbox (countersign@redwood.com). I'll prepare redlines: limit liability cap, standard indemnity, push back on 1yr log retention (propose 3 years for audit logs), and respond to the subprocessor list ask with our subprocessors + a security addendum offering notice for changes.

julia_revops: Finance won't accept net60 without mitigations. Options I can propose internally: (A) net30 + 25% deposit, (B) net60 with refundable security deposit equal to 1 invoice, or (C) net60 + 1.5% finance fee. Which do you want me to take?

sara_sales: Customer refuses deposits. They're tight on cash. Can we offer a one-time exception to net45 for the POC only? Need internal sign-off.

mike_legal: I can agree to net45 strictly for the POC if we add late fee language and set invoice day-of-month rounding to prevent ambiguity. I'll incorporate net45 clause into the order form redline.

laura_security: Uploaded SOC2 summary and a short note on KMS options to the shared drive. Suggest we include this text for customers: "Hosted: Redwood-managed KMS (us-west-2). Private/Dedicated deployments: customer-managed KMS/HSM supported; territory residency addendum required."

esign-bot: Envelope created: env_acme_5512. Routing order currently configured: sourcing@acme.com -> finance@acme.com -> legal@acme.com -> countersign@redwood.com. Preview: https://esign.redwood/envelope/env_acme_5512

sara_sales: Thanks. Next steps: Mike to push order form + DPA redline with net45 language; Julia to confirm finance fallback and payment path; Laura to send SOC2 + KMS note to procurement; Tim to provide private-vs-hosted cost delta. I'll update customer and confirm acceptance of net45 + DocuSign routing. cc @mike_legal @julia_revops @laura_security @tim_engineer

mike_legal: Drafting redline now. Expect updated PDF in ~2 hours.

julia_revops: I'll escalate net45 ask to finance and post the guidance back here today. If finance won't budge, we'll surface options B or C.

tim_engineer: Cost delta: Private POC ~ +18% TCO (estimated GPU+ops), Dedicated reserved capacity would be a larger commit—I'll include both quick numbers.

sara_sales: If procurement accepts net45 and DocuSign with countersign mailbox, we can proceed with the POC start next week. If they insist on KMS residency for hosted, need to confirm Private deployment budget.

mike_legal: Also note: we should refuse enumerated subprocessors as a hard requirement; instead provide the current list and an SLA for notice of changes. Will add that to redline.

Example envelope routing payload (for their AP team):
```json
{
  "envelopeId": "env_acme_5512",
  "routing": [
    "sourcing@acme.com",
    "finance@acme.com",
    "legal@acme.com",
    "countersign@redwood.com"
  ],
  "signingOrder": "sequential"
}
```

laura_security: Minor ask from procurement: proof of SOC2 + statement on encryption in transit + at-rest. I included links in the drive.

sara_sales: Great. I'll hold off messaging the customer until Mike posts the redline and Julia confirms finance.

mike_legal: Uploaded redline: order_form_v3_redline_net45_dpa.pdf and a DPA response memo. Please review and call out anything else.

julia_revops: Finance accepted net45 for this POC only with a clause: if usage exceeds agreed POC spend, payment terms revert to net30 for subsequent invoices. I'll add that to the doc.

sara_sales: Perfect. Sending to procurement now to confirm DocuSign flow, net45, and receipt of SOC2 docs.

-- thread end --
